title: A connected neighbourhood
question: How can small public spaces share a place without blocking one another?
summary: A corner shop, shelter, cycle parking, garden and charging bay share clear approaches. Explore how each object uses space.

entities.label: Corner shop
entities.description: The shop faces the shared walking route. Its public entrance and delivery access are separate.

entities.label: Bus shelter
entities.description: An open-sided shelter combines a roof, bench, timetable and stop sign. People enter beneath the roof.
entities.constraint: Leave the boarding approach free of street furniture.

entities.label: Cycle parking
entities.description: Three normal-sized hoops face a clear parking approach.
entities.constraint: Parking needs more space than the metal hoops occupy.

entities.label: Charging bay
entities.description: The cabinet and cable serve a marked vehicle bay. The supply connection is separate from vehicle access.
entities.constraint: The marked bay must remain clear for a vehicle.

entities.label: Community garden
entities.description: Raised planting beds sit inside a fence with a real opening.
entities.constraint: Walk through the gate rather than through plants or rails.

entities.label: Garden gate
entities.description: An L-shaped fence follows two edges of the garden. The gap is shared by its drawing and route checks.
entities.constraint: The gap must be wide enough for the whole walking corridor.

entities.label: Shade tree
entities.description: The canopy reaches beyond the trunk. A person can stand beneath its edge.
entities.constraint: Keep the route away from the trunk and below the canopy.

scenarios.label: Wait under the shelter
scenarios.summary: Follow the walking route into an open-sided shelter.

steps.title: Enter the shelter
steps.text: The neighbour reaches the waiting area beneath the roof, clear of the posts and bench.

state.caption: The neighbour reaches the waiting area beneath the roof, clear of the posts and bench.

scenarios.label: Collect a bicycle
scenarios.summary: Approach the cycle racks from their open side.

steps.title: Reach cycle parking
steps.text: The approach leaves space to manoeuvre a bicycle beside the hoops.

state.caption: The approach leaves space to manoeuvre a bicycle beside the hoops.

scenarios.label: Visit the garden
scenarios.summary: Use the real opening in the fence.
scenarios.outcome: The garden is reached without crossing rails or plants.

steps.title: Reach the gate
steps.text: The neighbour follows the shared path to the opening in the fence.

state.caption: The neighbour follows the shared path to the opening in the fence.

steps.title: Enter the garden
steps.text: The neighbour passes between the gateposts and stops beside the planting bed.

state.caption: The neighbour passes between the gateposts and stops beside the planting bed.

scenarios.label: Find some shade
scenarios.summary: Walk beneath the edge of the canopy.
scenarios.outcome: The tree provides shade while its trunk stays clear of the path.

steps.title: Step into the shade
steps.text: The neighbour stands beneath the canopy, with room between the path and trunk.

state.caption: The neighbour stands beneath the canopy, with room between the path and trunk.

scenarios.condition: The charging installation has a supply connection.
scenarios.outcome: Power reaches the cabinet beside the reserved vehicle bay.

steps.title: Supply the charging cabinet
steps.text: The cable connects the supply to the charging cabinet. Vehicle access uses the marked bay and road.
